name: qa-iac
description: Infrastructure-as-code testing: Checkov and Trivy misconfiguration scans, OPA, Conftest and Cedar policy tests, Helm chart tests, Terraform plan review. Trivy config is the tfsec successor, with the legacy tfsec workflow in references. A review agent (terraform-plan-reviewer) flags destructive and security-degrading plan changes. Cross-scanner IaC triage is handled by security-finding-triager in qa-security-scanning.
